status: Supplementary diagnostic defined after observing the AD seed11 104.858M prefix results; no training settings or model selection depend on this diagnostic
checkpoints: All ten methods, seed11, fixed final step16384 (1.074B tokens)
data: All 64 documents from the existing frozen long_v1 manifest; no new document selection
target: For every condition and document, exactly the same 1024 global target tokens at document indices7169..8192 inclusive (zero-based token indices)
interpretation: Reset-position conditions measure usable context extension on identical targets. Document-position conditions retain the full-document absolute RoPE positions while removing earlier context. Comparing reset/document positions at the same context size diagnoses sensitivity to absolute position separately from target difficulty.
implementation: Same frozen model blocks, BF16 backbone and FP32 linear attention. Explicit RoPE offset is the only forward change; final vocabulary projection scores only the fixed target band.
statistics: Per-document paired NLL differences; both document and hostname-cluster bootstrap intervals, conditional on one trained final-budget seed
limitations: Exploratory single-seed diagnostic, not a preregistered primary endpoint. Longer context also changes intermediate hidden representations. This diagnostic does not tune RoPE, alter models or establish universal architectural claims.
